_note: `model` may be a list: every job renders on every model with every seed (2 prompts x 3 models x 2 seeds = 12 images), each model in its own folder. Remove a model from the list to skip it. A LoRA belongs to one engine, so with a list of different engines give LoRAs per job with one model each - configs/full.json shows how.
